definitions: Relating to a telecommunications technique in which information is sent to an intermediate station where it is stored and then retransmitted to its destination.
Describing a system or method that involves receiving data, storing it temporarily, and then sending it on to the next destination.
examples: The store-and-forward mechanism ensures reliable delivery.
Many email systems operate on a store-and-forward basis.
This network uses a store-and-forward approach for message handling.
